<!-- Author: Kunru Song -->

Existing RDA object identifiers are retained for compatibility. Mplus folders,
run-file prefixes, reports, tables and figures use the current analysis numbering.

# Purpose and model sequence

This repository-only diagnostic compares the effect of a common residual
constraint on three nested two-level CFA models. The final constrained sequence
reported in the manuscript is presented in S2.6. The comparisons below examine the effect of the constraint:

1. **Model 1 (1W1B):** one general factor within persons and one general factor
   between persons;
2. **Model 2 (1W2B):** one general factor within persons and correlated
   Peripheral and Core factors between persons;
3. **Model 3 (2W2B):** correlated Peripheral and Core factors at both levels,
   corresponding to the unconstrained two-factor specification at both levels.

All six EMA indicators are treated as continuous and estimated with MLR in
Mplus 8.7. In the S2.5 constrained specification, the between-level residual variance of `P2` is fixed to zero in
all three models. The script also refits the corresponding unconstrained
models as a reproducible before-constraint reference. It therefore reports
changes in the principal fit indices, every STDYX factor loading, and the two
sequential Satorra--Bentler scaled likelihood-ratio tests. The tests retain the
order Model 2 versus Model 1 and Model 3 versus Model 2. The calculation follows the official
[Mplus guidance](https://www.statmodel.com/chidiff.shtml); ordinary subtraction
of the reported MLR chi-square statistics is not used.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
locate_project_root <- function(start = getwd()) {
  candidate <- normalizePath(start, winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE)
  if (!dir.exists(candidate)) candidate <- dirname(candidate)
  repeat {
    if (all(dir.exists(file.path(candidate, c(
      "Step_1_Descriptive_and_Reliability", "Step_2_Measurement_Models"
    ))))) return(candidate)
    parent <- dirname(candidate)
    if (identical(parent, candidate)) break
    candidate <- parent
  }
  stop("Could not identify the project root from the public Step folders")
}

public_diagnostics <- function(x) {
  columns <- c("condition", "model_id", "normal_termination", "errors_n",
    "warnings_n", "minimum_stdyx_residual_variance",
    "minimum_unstandardized_residual_variance", "negative_variance_flag",
    "theta_warning")
  stopifnot(is.data.frame(x), all(columns %in% names(x)))
  x[, columns, drop = FALSE]
}
read_saved_report <- function(path, input_path) {
  local_scope <- new.env(parent = emptyenv())
  loaded <- load(path, envir = local_scope)
  stopifnot(identical(loaded, "fit_s2_9_multilevel_cfa_new_model_order"))
  x <- local_scope[[loaded]]
  ids <- c("M1_1W1B", "M2_1W2B", "M3_2W2B")
  stopifnot(is.list(x), isTRUE(x$metadata$s2_9_passed),
    identical(x$metadata$input_md5, unname(tools::md5sum(input_path))),
    identical(x$metadata$mplus_version, "8.7"),
    identical(x$metadata$estimator, "MLR"),
    identical(x$metadata$analysis_type, "TWOLEVEL"),
    identical(as.character(x$model_plan$model_id), ids),
    identical(as.character(x$fit_change$model_id), ids),
    identical(names(x$loading_change), ids),
    identical(as.character(x$sequential_test_change$comparison),
      c("Model 2 vs Model 1", "Model 3 vs Model 2")),
    nrow(x$sample_audit) == 1L, ncol(x$sample_audit) == 8L,
    x$sample_audit$scheduled_rows == 18810L,
    x$sample_audit$participants == 209L,
    x$sample_audit$outcome_informative_rows == 17759L,
    nrow(x$variable_map) == 6L, ncol(x$variable_map) == 4L,
    nrow(x$model_plan) == 3L, ncol(x$model_plan) == 10L,
    nrow(x$fit_change) == 3L, ncol(x$fit_change) == 39L,
    nrow(x$sequential_test_change) == 2L,
    ncol(x$sequential_test_change) == 13L,
    all(vapply(x$loading_change, nrow, integer(1)) == 12L),
    all(vapply(x$loading_change, ncol, integer(1)) == 13L))
  for (fit in list(x$reference_model_fit, x$model_fit)) {
    stopifnot(nrow(fit) == 3L, identical(as.character(fit$model_id), ids),
      all(fit$normal_termination), all(fit$mplus_version == "8.7"),
      all(fit$estimator == "MLR"), all(fit$observations == 17759L),
      all(fit$clusters == 209L))
  }
  diagnostic <- dplyr::bind_rows(public_diagnostics(x$reference_diagnostics),
    public_diagnostics(x$diagnostics))
  stopifnot(nrow(diagnostic) == 6L, all(diagnostic$normal_termination),
    all(diagnostic$errors_n == 0L),
    all(is.finite(diagnostic$warnings_n)), all(diagnostic$warnings_n >= 0L),
    !anyNA(diagnostic$negative_variance_flag), !anyNA(diagnostic$theta_warning),
    identical(as.character(diagnostic$model_id), rep(ids, 2L)),
    identical(as.character(diagnostic$condition), rep(c("Before P2@0", "After P2@0"), each = 3L)))
  # Only aggregate display objects leave this function; parsed models, raw
  # warnings, identifiers, Mplus paths and provenance environments stay private.
  list(sample_audit = x$sample_audit, variable_map = x$variable_map,
    model_plan = x$model_plan, fit_change = x$fit_change,
    sequential_test_change = x$sequential_test_change,
    loading_change = x$loading_change, diagnostics = diagnostic)
}
report_table <- function(x, digits = 4L) {
  cat('<div class="table-scroll">\n')
  print(knitr::kable(x, format = "html", digits = digits, row.names = FALSE))
  cat('</div>\n\n')
}
```

# Define the revised three-model sequence and the before-constraint reference

`FW`, `PW`, and `CW` denote within-person general, Peripheral, and Core
factors; `FB`, `PB`, and `CB` denote the corresponding between-person factors.

```{r model-specifications, eval=!use_saved_results}
reference_model_specs <- list(
  M1_1W1B = list(
    order = 1L,
    label = "Model 1: 1W1B",
    stem = "s2_5_m1_1w1b",
    title = "S2.5 Model 1 before P2 residual constraint;",
    within_structure = "General PSMU",
    between_structure = "General PSMU",
    model = paste(
      "%WITHIN%",
      "fw BY p1-p6;",
      "%BETWEEN%",
      "fb BY p1-p6;",
      sep = "\n"
    )
  ),
  M2_1W2B = list(
    order = 2L,
    label = "Model 2: 1W2B",
    stem = "s2_5_m2_1w2b",
    title = "S2.5 Model 2 before P2 residual constraint;",
    within_structure = "General PSMU",
    between_structure = "Peripheral + Core",
    model = paste(
      "%WITHIN%",
      "fw BY p1-p6;",
      "%BETWEEN%",
      "pb BY p1-p2;",
      "cb BY p3-p6;",
      "pb WITH cb;",
      sep = "\n"
    )
  ),
  M3_2W2B = list(
    order = 3L,
    label = "Model 3: 2W2B (original M3a)",
    stem = "s2_5_m3_2w2b",
    title = "S2.5 Model 3 before P2 residual constraint;",
    within_structure = "Peripheral + Core",
    between_structure = "Peripheral + Core",
    model = paste(
      "%WITHIN%",
      "pw BY p1-p2;",
      "cw BY p3-p6;",
      "pw WITH cw;",
      "%BETWEEN%",
      "pb BY p1-p2;",
      "cb BY p3-p6;",
      "pb WITH cb;",
      sep = "\n"
    )
  )
)

model_specs <- list(
```

# Fit the three P2@0 models and their before-constraint references in Mplus 8.7

```{r fit-mplus-models, eval=!use_saved_results}
flatten_messages <- function(x) {
  if (!length(x)) return(NA_character_)
  values <- trimws(as.character(unlist(x, recursive = TRUE, use.names = FALSE)))
  values <- values[nzchar(values)]
  if (!length(values)) NA_character_ else paste(unique(values), collapse = " | ")
}

run_mplus_model <- function(
  model_id,
  specification,
  condition,
  require_p2_between_residual_zero
) {
  model_stem <- specification$stem
  data_path <- file.path(mplus_directory, paste0(model_stem, ".dat"))
  input_path <- file.path(mplus_directory, paste0(model_stem, ".inp"))
  output_path <- file.path(mplus_directory, paste0(model_stem, ".out"))

  mplus_object <- MplusAutomation::mplusObject(
    TITLE = paste(
      "! Author: Kunru Song",
      "! Missing values are declared as . and handled by default MLR FIML.",
      specification$title,
      sep = "\n"
    ),
    VARIABLE = "CLUSTER = cluster;",
    ANALYSIS = paste(
      "TYPE = TWOLEVEL;",
      "ESTIMATOR = MLR;",
      sep = "\n"
    ),
    MODEL = specification$model,
    OUTPUT = paste(
      "SAMPSTAT;",
      "STANDARDIZED(STDYX);",
      "CINTERVAL;",
      "RESIDUAL;",
      "TECH1;",
      "TECH4;",
      sep = "\n"
    ),
    usevariables = c("cluster", mplus_item_names),
    rdata = mplus_data,
    autov = FALSE,
    quiet = TRUE
  )

  MplusAutomation::mplusModeler(
    object = mplus_object,
    dataout = data_path,
    modelout = input_path,
    run = 1L,
    check = FALSE,
    varwarnings = TRUE,
    Mplus_command = mplus_command,
    writeData = "always",
    hashfilename = FALSE,
    killOnFail = TRUE,
    quiet = TRUE
  )

  stopifnot(file.exists(input_path), file.exists(output_path))
  input_lines <- readLines(input_path, warn = FALSE)
  output_lines <- readLines(output_path, warn = FALSE)
  p2_zero_count <- sum(grepl(
    "^\\s*p2\\s*@\\s*0\\s*;\\s*$",
    input_lines,
    ignore.case = TRUE,
    perl = TRUE
  ))
  other_indicator_zero_count <- sum(grepl(
    "^\\s*p(1|3|4|5|6)\\s*@\\s*0\\s*;\\s*$",
    input_lines,
    ignore.case = TRUE,
    perl = TRUE
  ))
  input_checks <- list(
    author_present = any(trimws(input_lines) == "! Author: Kunru Song"),
    missing_declared = any(grepl(
      "MISSING\\s*=\\s*\\.;", input_lines, ignore.case = TRUE, perl = TRUE
    )),
    mlr_declared = any(grepl(
      "ESTIMATOR\\s*=\\s*MLR;", input_lines, ignore.case = TRUE, perl = TRUE
    )),
    twolevel_declared = any(grepl(
      "TYPE\\s*=\\s*TWOLEVEL;", input_lines, ignore.case = TRUE, perl = TRUE
    )),
    cluster_declared = any(grepl(
      "CLUSTER\\s*=\\s*cluster;", input_lines, ignore.case = TRUE, perl = TRUE
    )),
    categorical_absent = !any(grepl(
      "CATEGORICAL", input_lines, ignore.case = TRUE, fixed = TRUE
    )),
    p2_between_residual_constraint_matches_condition = if (
      require_p2_between_residual_zero
    ) p2_zero_count == 1L else p2_zero_count == 0L,
    no_other_indicator_residual_zero_constraint = other_indicator_zero_count == 0L
  )
  stopifnot(all(unlist(input_checks, use.names = FALSE)))

  normal_termination <- any(grepl(
    "THE MODEL ESTIMATION TERMINATED NORMALLY",
    output_lines,
    fixed = TRUE
  ))
  parsed <- MplusAutomation::readModels(
    target = output_path,
    what = "all",
    quiet = TRUE
  )

  list(
    model_id = model_id,
    model_label = specification$label,
    model_order = specification$order,
    condition = condition,
    specification = specification,
    model_syntax = specification$model,
    paths = list(data = data_path, input = input_path, output = output_path),
    input_checks = input_checks,
    normal_termination = normal_termination,
    parsed = parsed
  )
}

reference_model_runs <- lapply(names(reference_model_specs), function(model_id) {
  run_mplus_model(
    model_id,
    reference_model_specs[[model_id]],
    condition = "Before P2@0",
    require_p2_between_residual_zero = FALSE
  )
})
names(reference_model_runs) <- names(reference_model_specs)

model_runs <- lapply(names(model_specs), function(model_id) {
  run_mplus_model(
    model_id,
    model_specs[[model_id]],
    condition = "After P2@0",
    require_p2_between_residual_zero = TRUE
  )
})
names(model_runs) <- names(model_specs)

all_model_runs <- c(reference_model_runs, model_runs)
if (!all(vapply(all_model_runs, `[[`, logical(1), "normal_termination"))) {
  stop("At least one S2.5 before/after Mplus model did not terminate normally.")
}
```

# Extract complete model-fit information

```{r extract-model-fit, eval=!use_saved_results}
summary_value <- function(summary_row, candidates, type = c("numeric", "character")) {
  type <- match.arg(type)
  available <- candidates[candidates %in% names(summary_row)]
  if (!length(available)) {
    return(if (type == "numeric") NA_real_ else NA_character_)
  }
  value <- summary_row[[available[1L]]][1L]
  if (type == "numeric") as.numeric(value) else as.character(value)
}

mplus_numeric <- function(x) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.character(x)))

parse_output_integer <- function(path, pattern) {
  lines <- readLines(path, warn = FALSE)
  hit <- grep(pattern, lines, ignore.case = TRUE, value = TRUE, perl = TRUE)
  if (!length(hit)) return(NA_integer_)
  digits <- sub(".*?([0-9]+)\\s*$", "\\1", hit[1L], perl = TRUE)
  suppressWarnings(as.integer(digits))
}

extract_model_fit <- function(run) {
  summary_row <- run$parsed$summaries[1, , drop = FALSE]
  specification <- run$specification
  data.frame(
    condition = run$condition,
    model_order = run$model_order,
    model_id = run$model_id,
    model = run$model_label,
    within_structure = specification$within_structure,
    between_structure = specification$between_structure,
    mplus_version = summary_value(summary_row, "Mplus.version", "character"),
    estimator = summary_value(summary_row, "Estimator", "character"),
    analysis_type = summary_value(summary_row, "AnalysisType", "character"),
    observations = summary_value(summary_row, "Observations", "numeric"),
    clusters = parse_output_integer(run$paths$output, "Number of clusters"),
    free_parameters = summary_value(summary_row, "Parameters", "numeric"),
    scaled_chi_square = summary_value(summary_row, "ChiSqM_Value", "numeric"),
    df = summary_value(summary_row, "ChiSqM_DF", "numeric"),
    chi_square_p = summary_value(summary_row, "ChiSqM_PValue", "numeric"),
    robust_scaling_correction = summary_value(
      summary_row, "ChiSqM_ScalingCorrection", "numeric"
    ),

    ),

    normal_termination = run$normal_termination,
    warnings = flatten_messages(run$parsed$warnings),
    errors = flatten_messages(run$parsed$errors),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}
```

# Sequential Satorra--Bentler scaled likelihood-ratio tests

For the more restrictive model 0 and less restrictive model 1, the official
MLR calculation is

\[
c_d = \frac{d_0c_0-d_1c_1}{d_0-d_1}, \qquad
T_{Rd} = \frac{T_0c_0-T_1c_1}{c_d}.
\]

Here, \(T\), \(d\), and \(c\) are the Mplus-reported scaled chi-square,
degrees of freedom, and scaling correction factor, respectively.

```{r sequential-scaled-tests, eval=!use_saved_results}
get_fit_row <- function(fit_table, model_id) {
  row <- fit_table[fit_table$model_id == model_id, , drop = FALSE]
  if (nrow(row) != 1L) stop("Could not find a unique fit row for ", model_id)
  row
}

scaled_mlr_difference <- function(
  fit_table,
  condition,
  order,
  comparison,
  h0_id,
  h1_id,
  tested_split
) {
  h0 <- get_fit_row(fit_table, h0_id)
  h1 <- get_fit_row(fit_table, h1_id)
  difference_df <- h0$df - h1$df
  if (!is.finite(difference_df) || difference_df <= 0) {
    stop("Invalid nested-model degrees-of-freedom difference for ", comparison)
  }
  difference_scaling_correction <- (
    h0$df * h0$robust_scaling_correction -
      h1$df * h1$robust_scaling_correction
  ) / difference_df
  scaled_difference_chi_square <- (
    h0$scaled_chi_square * h0$robust_scaling_correction -
      h1$scaled_chi_square * h1$robust_scaling_correction
  ) / difference_scaling_correction
  difference_p <- stats::pchisq(
    scaled_difference_chi_square,
    df = difference_df,
    lower.tail = FALSE
  )

  data.frame(
    condition = condition,
    comparison_order = order,
    comparison = comparison,
    tested_split = tested_split,
    more_restrictive_h0 = h0_id,
    less_restrictive_h1 = h1_id,
    h0_scaled_chi_square = h0$scaled_chi_square,
    h0_df = h0$df,
    h0_scaling_correction = h0$robust_scaling_correction,
    h1_scaled_chi_square = h1$scaled_chi_square,
    h1_df = h1$df,
    h1_scaling_correction = h1$robust_scaling_correction,
    difference_scaling_correction = difference_scaling_correction,
    scaled_difference_chi_square = scaled_difference_chi_square,
    difference_df = difference_df,
    difference_p = difference_p,
    conclusion = ifelse(
      difference_p < .05,
      paste0(h1_id, " fits significantly better than ", h0_id),
      paste0(h1_id, " does not fit significantly better than ", h0_id)
    ),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

build_sequential_tests <- function(fit_table, condition) dplyr::bind_rows(
  scaled_mlr_difference(
    fit_table = fit_table,
    condition = condition,
    order = 1L,
    comparison = "Model 2 vs Model 1",
    h0_id = "M1_1W1B",
    h1_id = "M2_1W2B",
    tested_split = "Between-person General factor versus Peripheral + Core"
  ),
  scaled_mlr_difference(
    fit_table = fit_table,
    condition = condition,
    order = 2L,
    comparison = "Model 3 vs Model 2",
    h0_id = "M2_1W2B",
    h1_id = "M3_2W2B",
    tested_split = "Within-person General factor versus Peripheral + Core"
  )
)

reference_sequential_tests <- build_sequential_tests(
  reference_model_fit,
  "Before P2@0"
)
sequential_tests <- build_sequential_tests(model_fit, "After P2@0")

stopifnot(
  nrow(reference_sequential_tests) == 2L,
  nrow(sequential_tests) == 2L,
  all(reference_sequential_tests$difference_df > 0),
  all(sequential_tests$difference_df > 0),
  all(reference_sequential_tests$difference_scaling_correction > 0),
  all(sequential_tests$difference_scaling_correction > 0),
  all(reference_sequential_tests$scaled_difference_chi_square >= 0),
  all(sequential_tests$scaled_difference_chi_square >= 0),
  all(reference_sequential_tests$difference_p >= 0 &
        reference_sequential_tests$difference_p <= 1),
  all(sequential_tests$difference_p >= 0 & sequential_tests$difference_p <= 1)
)

sequential_test_change <- reference_sequential_tests |>
  dplyr::select(
    comparison_order, comparison, tested_split,
    difference_scaling_correction_before = difference_scaling_correction,
    scaled_difference_chi_square_before = scaled_difference_chi_square,
    difference_df_before = difference_df,
    difference_p_before = difference_p
  ) |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    sequential_tests |>
      dplyr::select(
        comparison,
        difference_scaling_correction_after = difference_scaling_correction,
        scaled_difference_chi_square_after = scaled_difference_chi_square,
        difference_df_after = difference_df,
        difference_p_after = difference_p
      ),
    by = "comparison"
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    scaled_difference_chi_square_change =
      scaled_difference_chi_square_after - scaled_difference_chi_square_before,
    difference_p_change = difference_p_after - difference_p_before
  )

```

# Extract complete STDYX results for each model

```{r extract-stdyx, eval=!use_saved_results}
factor_labels <- c(
  FW = "Within General PSMU",
  PW = "Within Peripheral",
  CW = "Within Core",
  FB = "Between General PSMU",
  PB = "Between Peripheral",
  CB = "Between Core"
)
item_labels <- setNames(ema_items, toupper(mplus_item_names))

label_parameter <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  factor_hit <- x %in% names(factor_labels)
  item_hit <- x %in% names(item_labels)
  x[factor_hit] <- unname(factor_labels[x[factor_hit]])
  x[item_hit] <- unname(item_labels[x[item_hit]])
  x
}

extract_stdyx <- function(run) {
  standard <- run$parsed$parameters$stdyx.standardized |>
    dplyr::mutate(dplyr::across(
      dplyr::any_of(c("est", "se", "est_se", "pval")),
      mplus_numeric
    ))
  standard_ci <- run$parsed$parameters$ci.stdyx.standardized |>
    dplyr::mutate(dplyr::across(
      dplyr::any_of(c("low2.5", "up2.5")),
      mplus_numeric
    )) |>
    dplyr::select(
      paramHeader,
      param,
      BetweenWithin,
      ci_lower = low2.5,
      ci_upper = up2.5
    )

  standard |>
    dplyr::left_join(
      standard_ci,
      by = c("paramHeader", "param", "BetweenWithin")
    ) |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      parameter_group = dplyr::case_when(
        grepl("\\.BY$", paramHeader) ~ "Factor loading",
        grepl("\\.WITH$", paramHeader) ~ "Factor covariance/correlation",
        paramHeader == "Variances" ~ "Latent variance",
        paramHeader == "Residual.Variances" ~ "Residual variance",
        paramHeader == "Intercepts" ~ "Indicator intercept",
        TRUE ~ paramHeader
      ),
      lhs_code = dplyr::case_when(
        grepl("\\.(BY|WITH)$", paramHeader) ~ sub("\\.(BY|WITH)$", "", paramHeader),
        TRUE ~ param
      ),
      operator = dplyr::case_when(
        grepl("\\.BY$", paramHeader) ~ "BY",
        grepl("\\.WITH$", paramHeader) ~ "WITH",
        paramHeader == "Variances" ~ "VAR",
        paramHeader == "Residual.Variances" ~ "RESIDUAL_VAR",
        paramHeader == "Intercepts" ~ "INTERCEPT",
        TRUE ~ paramHeader
      ),
      rhs_code = dplyr::case_when(
        grepl("\\.(BY|WITH)$", paramHeader) ~ param,
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      ),
      lhs = label_parameter(lhs_code),
      rhs = label_parameter(rhs_code),
      fixed_or_not_tested = is.na(pval) | pval >= 900 | se == 0,
      se_clean = ifelse(fixed_or_not_tested, NA_real_, se),
      z_clean = ifelse(fixed_or_not_tested, NA_real_, est_se),
      p_clean = ifelse(fixed_or_not_tested, NA_real_, pval),
      ci_lower_clean = ifelse(abs(ci_lower) >= 998, NA_real_, ci_lower),
      ci_upper_clean = ifelse(abs(ci_upper) >= 998, NA_real_, ci_upper)
    ) |>
    dplyr::transmute(
      condition = run$condition,
      model_order = run$model_order,
      model_id = run$model_id,
      model = run$model_label,
      level = BetweenWithin,
      parameter_group,
      lhs,
      operator,
      rhs,
      mplus_parameter_header = paramHeader,
      mplus_parameter = param,
      stdyx_estimate = est,
      stdyx_se = se_clean,
      stdyx_z = z_clean,
      stdyx_p = p_clean,
      ci_95_lower = ci_lower_clean,
      ci_95_upper = ci_upper_clean,
      fixed_or_not_tested
    ) |>
    dplyr::arrange(
      factor(level, levels = c("Within", "Between")),
      factor(parameter_group, levels = c(
        "Factor loading",
        "Factor covariance/correlation",
        "Latent variance",
        "Indicator intercept",
        "Residual variance"
      )),
      lhs,
      rhs
    )
}

reference_stdyx_results <- lapply(reference_model_runs, extract_stdyx)
names(reference_stdyx_results) <- names(reference_model_runs)
stdyx_results <- lapply(model_runs, extract_stdyx)

  all(vapply(stdyx_results, function(x) {

)

  "model_order", "model_id", "level", "parameter_group", "lhs", "operator",

)
comparison_metrics <- c(
  "stdyx_estimate", "stdyx_se", "stdyx_z", "stdyx_p",
  "ci_95_lower", "ci_95_upper", "fixed_or_not_tested"

build_stdyx_change <- function(model_id) {
  before <- reference_stdyx_results[[model_id]] |>
    dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(parameter_keys), dplyr::all_of(comparison_metrics)) |>
    dplyr::rename_with(~ paste0(.x, "_before"), dplyr::all_of(comparison_metrics))
  after <- stdyx_results[[model_id]] |>
    dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(parameter_keys), dplyr::all_of(comparison_metrics)) |>
    dplyr::rename_with(~ paste0(.x, "_after"), dplyr::all_of(comparison_metrics))

  dplyr::full_join(before, after, by = parameter_keys) |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      stdyx_estimate_change = stdyx_estimate_after - stdyx_estimate_before,
      model = model_specs[[.env$model_id]]$label,
      .after = model_id
    ) |>
    dplyr::arrange(
      factor(level, levels = c("Within", "Between")),
      factor(parameter_group, levels = c(
        "Factor loading", "Factor covariance/correlation", "Latent variance",
        "Indicator intercept", "Residual variance"
      )),
      lhs,
      rhs
    )
}

stdyx_change <- lapply(names(model_specs), build_stdyx_change)
names(stdyx_change) <- names(model_specs)
loading_change <- lapply(stdyx_change, function(x) {
  x |>
    dplyr::filter(parameter_group == "Factor loading") |>
    dplyr::select(
      model_order, model_id, model, level, factor = lhs, item = rhs,
      stdyx_loading_before = stdyx_estimate_before,
      stdyx_loading_after = stdyx_estimate_after,
      stdyx_loading_change = stdyx_estimate_change,
      ci_95_lower_before, ci_95_upper_before,
      ci_95_lower_after, ci_95_upper_after
    )
})

stopifnot(
  all(vapply(loading_change, nrow, integer(1)) == 12L),

    all(is.finite(x$stdyx_loading_before)) &&
      all(is.finite(x$stdyx_loading_after)) &&
      all(is.finite(x$stdyx_loading_change))
  }, logical(1)))
)
```

# Diagnostics

The before-constraint diagnostics retain the prior negative-residual evidence.
The revised primary models are expected to remove that issue by fixing the
between-level `P2` residual variance to zero in every model.

Raw warning text can contain participant-specific cluster lists and is omitted
from this public display. Original warning/error counts, residual minima and
admissibility flags remain visible. Normal termination is not evidence of
acceptable fit or an admissible unconstrained solution.

```{r diagnostics, eval=!use_saved_results}
extract_diagnostics <- function(run) {
  standard <- run$parsed$parameters$stdyx.standardized |>
    dplyr::mutate(est = mplus_numeric(est))
  residual_rows <- standard[
    standard$paramHeader == "Residual.Variances",
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]
  unstandard <- run$parsed$parameters$unstandardized |>
    dplyr::mutate(est = mplus_numeric(est))
  residual_unstandardized <- unstandard[
    unstandard$paramHeader == "Residual.Variances",
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]
  warnings_text <- flatten_messages(run$parsed$warnings)
  errors_text <- flatten_messages(run$parsed$errors)

  data.frame(
    condition = run$condition,
    model_id = run$model_id,
    normal_termination = run$normal_termination,
    errors_n = length(run$parsed$errors),
    warnings_n = length(run$parsed$warnings),
    errors = errors_text,
    warnings = warnings_text,
    minimum_stdyx_residual_variance = if (nrow(residual_rows)) {
      min(residual_rows$est, na.rm = TRUE)
    } else NA_real_,
    minimum_unstandardized_residual_variance = if (nrow(residual_unstandardized)) {
      min(residual_unstandardized$est, na.rm = TRUE)
    } else NA_real_,
    negative_variance_flag = if (nrow(residual_unstandardized)) {
      any(residual_unstandardized$est < 0, na.rm = TRUE)
    } else FALSE,
    theta_warning = !is.na(warnings_text) && grepl(
      "THETA.*NOT POSITIVE DEFINITE",
      warnings_text,
      ignore.case = TRUE
    ),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

reference_diagnostics <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(
  reference_model_runs,
  extract_diagnostics
))
diagnostics <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(model_runs, extract_diagnostics))
stopifnot(
  all(reference_diagnostics$normal_termination),
  all(reference_diagnostics$errors_n == 0L),
  all(diagnostics$normal_termination),
  all(diagnostics$errors_n == 0L),
  !any(diagnostics$negative_variance_flag),
  !any(diagnostics$theta_warning)
)
```

```{r export-workbook, include=FALSE, eval=!use_saved_results}
  fontSize = 10,
  fontColour = "#FFFFFF",
  fgFill = "#1F4E78",
  textDecoration = "bold",
  halign = "center",
  valign = "center",
  wrapText = TRUE,
  border = "bottom",
  borderColour = "#163A5C"
)
body_style <- openxlsx::createStyle(fontName = "Arial", fontSize = 9)
decimal_style <- openxlsx::createStyle(numFmt = "0.0000")
integer_style <- openxlsx::createStyle(numFmt = "0")
comparison_style <- openxlsx::createStyle(fgFill = "#EAF2F8")

for (sheet_name in names(workbook_sheets)) {
  sheet_data <- workbook_sheets[[sheet_name]]
  n_rows <- nrow(sheet_data)
  n_columns <- ncol(sheet_data)
  openxlsx::addStyle(
    workbook,
    sheet = sheet_name,
    style = header_style,
    rows = 1,
    cols = seq_len(n_columns),
    gridExpand = TRUE,
    stack = TRUE
  )
  if (n_rows > 0L) {
    openxlsx::addStyle(
      workbook,
      sheet = sheet_name,
      style = body_style,
      rows = 2:(n_rows + 1L),
      cols = seq_len(n_columns),
      gridExpand = TRUE,
      stack = TRUE
    )
    numeric_columns <- which(vapply(sheet_data, is.numeric, logical(1)))
    integer_columns <- which(names(sheet_data) %in% c(
      "order", "observations", "clusters", "free_parameters", "df",
      "difference_df", "model_order", "df_before", "df_after", "df_change",
      "difference_df_before", "difference_df_after"
    ))
    decimal_columns <- setdiff(numeric_columns, integer_columns)
    if (length(integer_columns)) {
      openxlsx::addStyle(
        workbook, sheet_name, integer_style,
        rows = 2:(n_rows + 1L), cols = integer_columns,
        gridExpand = TRUE, stack = TRUE
      )
    }
    if (length(decimal_columns)) {
      openxlsx::addStyle(
        workbook, sheet_name, decimal_style,
        rows = 2:(n_rows + 1L), cols = decimal_columns,
        gridExpand = TRUE, stack = TRUE
      )
    }
  }
  widths <- vapply(seq_len(n_columns), function(index) {
    values <- c(names(sheet_data)[index], as.character(sheet_data[[index]]))
    values[is.na(values)] <- ""
    min(42, max(10, max(nchar(values), na.rm = TRUE) + 2))
  }, numeric(1))
  openxlsx::setColWidths(
    workbook,
    sheet = sheet_name,
    cols = seq_len(n_columns),
    widths = widths
  )
  openxlsx::setRowHeights(workbook, sheet_name, rows = 1, heights = 32)
  openxlsx::freezePane(workbook, sheet_name, firstRow = TRUE)
  openxlsx::addFilter(workbook, sheet_name, rows = 1, cols = seq_len(n_columns))
  openxlsx::showGridLines(workbook, sheet_name, showGridLines = FALSE)
  openxlsx::pageSetup(
    workbook,
    sheet = sheet_name,
    orientation = "landscape",
    fitToWidth = 1,
    fitToHeight = 0
  )
}

repair_orphan_drawing_relationships <- function(xlsx_file) {
  repair_dir <- tempfile("baseline_cfa_xlsx_repair_")
  dir.create(repair_dir)
  on.exit(unlink(repair_dir, recursive = TRUE, force = TRUE), add = TRUE)

  members <- utils::unzip(xlsx_file, list = TRUE)$Name
  # Reject unsafe archive paths before extracting a package.
  unsafe_member <- function(path) {
    parts <- strsplit(gsub("\\\\", "/", path), "/", fixed = TRUE)[[1L]]
    grepl("^[/\\\\]|^[A-Za-z]:", path) || any(parts == "..")
  }
  stopifnot(length(members) > 0L, !anyDuplicated(members),
            !any(vapply(members, unsafe_member, logical(1))))
  utils::unzip(xlsx_file, exdir = repair_dir)
  relationship_files <- list.files(
    file.path(repair_dir, "xl", "worksheets", "_rels"),
    pattern = "\\.rels$", full.names = TRUE
  )
  if (!length(relationship_files)) return(invisible(0L))

  resolve_member <- function(target) {
    target <- gsub("\\\\", "/", utils::URLdecode(target))
    if (!nzchar(target) || grepl("^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9+.-]*:", target)) {
      stop("Invalid internal drawing target")
    }
    parts <- strsplit(target, "/", fixed = TRUE)[[1L]]
    result <- if (startsWith(target, "/")) character() else c("xl", "worksheets")
    for (part in parts) {
      if (!nzchar(part) || part == ".") next
      if (part == "..") {
        if (!length(result)) stop("Drawing target escapes the workbook package")
        result <- head(result, -1L)
      } else result <- c(result, part)
    }
    paste(result, collapse = "/")
  }
  drawing_types <- paste0(
    "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships/",
    c("drawing", "vmlDrawing")
  )
  removed_relationships <- 0L
  for (relationship_file in relationship_files) {
    document <- xml2::read_xml(relationship_file, options = "NONET")
    relationships <- xml2::xml_find_all(
      document, "/*[local-name()='Relationships']/*[local-name()='Relationship']"
    )
    changed <- FALSE
    for (relationship in relationships) {
      type <- xml2::xml_attr(relationship, "Type")
      external <- identical(xml2::xml_attr(relationship, "TargetMode"), "External")
      if (!type %in% drawing_types || external) next
      target <- xml2::xml_attr(relationship, "Target")
      if (is.na(target)) stop("Drawing relationship is missing its Target")
      if (!resolve_member(target) %in% members) {
        xml2::xml_remove(relationship)
        removed_relationships <- removed_relationships + 1L
        changed <- TRUE
      }
    }
    if (changed) xml2::write_xml(document, relationship_file)
  }
  if (removed_relationships == 0L) return(invisible(0L))

  repaired_file <- tempfile(fileext = ".xlsx")
  on.exit(unlink(repaired_file), add = TRUE)
  archive_members <- list.files(
    repair_dir, recursive = TRUE, all.files = TRUE, no.. = TRUE
  )
  zip::zipr(
    zipfile = repaired_file, files = archive_members, root = repair_dir,
    include_directories = FALSE, mode = "mirror"
  )
  stopifnot(file.exists(repaired_file), file.info(repaired_file)$size > 0)
  stopifnot(file.copy(repaired_file, xlsx_file, overwrite = TRUE))
  invisible(removed_relationships)
}

orphan_relationships_removed <- repair_orphan_drawing_relationships(table_file)
stopifnot(
  file.exists(table_file),
  file.info(table_file)$size > 0,
  identical(openxlsx::getSheetNames(table_file), names(workbook_sheets))
)
```

```{r save-result-bundle, include=FALSE, eval=!use_saved_results}
project_root_normalized <- normalizePath(project_root, winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE)
make_relative_path <- function(path) {
  normalized <- normalizePath(path, winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE)
  prefix <- paste0(project_root_normalized, "/")
  if (startsWith(normalized, prefix)) {
    substring(normalized, nchar(prefix) + 1L)
  } else normalized
}
```

```{r validation-checks, include=FALSE, eval=!use_saved_results}
validation_checks <- data.frame(
  check = c(
    "S2.1 measurement input reloaded as its sole expected object",
    "Three P2@0 models and three before-constraint references ran in Mplus 8.7",
    "Every Mplus input contains the exact author text and correct constraint status",
    "All six models terminated normally with 17,759 observations and 209 clusters",
    "Every revised model fixes only the between-level P2 residual variance to zero",
    "Before/after sequential scaled MLR tests were computed in the requested order",
    "Before/after fit and loading changes were calculated for all three models",
    "The four-sheet workbook reloaded with the expected sheet names and dimensions",
    "The canonical S2.5 RDA reloaded as its sole expected object",
    "All 18 Mplus audit files exist and match their stored MD5 hashes"
  ),
  passed = c(
    identical(loaded_objects, "dat_step2_measurement"),
    length(reference_model_runs) == 3L && length(model_runs) == 3L &&
      all(c(reference_model_fit$mplus_version, model_fit$mplus_version) == "8.7"),
    all(vapply(all_model_runs, function(x) {
      all(unlist(x$input_checks))
    }, logical(1))),
    all(reference_model_fit$normal_termination) &&
      all(reference_model_fit$observations == 17759L) &&
      all(reference_model_fit$clusters == 209L) &&
    all(model_fit$normal_termination) &&
      all(model_fit$observations == 17759L) &&
      all(model_fit$clusters == 209L),
    all(vapply(model_specs, function(x) {
      sum(grepl("^p2@0;$", strsplit(x$model, "\n", fixed = TRUE)[[1L]],
                ignore.case = TRUE)) == 1L
    }, logical(1))) &&
      all(vapply(reference_model_specs, function(x) {
        !any(grepl("@0;", strsplit(x$model, "\n", fixed = TRUE)[[1L]],
                   fixed = TRUE))
      }, logical(1))),
    identical(
      sequential_tests$comparison,
      c("Model 2 vs Model 1", "Model 3 vs Model 2")
    ) && identical(reference_sequential_tests$comparison,
                   sequential_tests$comparison),
    nrow(fit_change) == 3L && nrow(sequential_test_change) == 2L &&
      all(vapply(loading_change, nrow, integer(1)) == 12L),
    identical(readxl::excel_sheets(table_file), names(workbook_sheets)) &&
      identical(workbook_audit$rows, c(
        nrow(fit_and_comparisons),
        nrow(stdyx_change$M1_1W1B),
        nrow(stdyx_change$M2_1W2B),
        nrow(stdyx_change$M3_2W2B)
      )),
    identical(verified_objects, "fit_s2_9_multilevel_cfa_new_model_order"),
    nrow(mplus_file_manifest) == 18L &&
      all(file.exists(file.path(project_root, mplus_file_manifest$relative_path))) &&
      identical(
        unname(tools::md5sum(file.path(project_root, mplus_file_manifest$relative_path))),
        mplus_file_manifest$md5
      )
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

if (!all(validation_checks$passed)) {
  stop(
    "S2.5 validation failed: ",
    paste(validation_checks$check[!validation_checks$passed], collapse = "; ")
  )
}


```

S2.5 reports how fixing the between-level `P2` residual variance to zero in all
three models changes comparative fit, STDYX factor loadings, and the sequential scaled MLR tests. A significant test indicates that the added
level-specific Core--Peripheral distinction improves fit relative to the
immediately preceding model; it does not by itself establish good absolute fit.
